description: OMOP CDM v5.4 VISIT_OCCURRENCE table — encounters where the person engages with the healthcare system for a duration of time.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each person's visit or encounter at a healthcare provider.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the person for whom the visit is recorded. The demographic details of that person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Visit Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a visit concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies.

fields.label: Visit Start Date
fields.description: The start date of the visit.

fields.label: Visit Start Datetime
fields.description: The date and time of the visit started.

fields.label: Visit End Date
fields.description: The end date of the visit. If this is a one-day visit the end date should match the start date.

fields.label: Visit End Datetime
fields.description: The date and time of the visit end.

fields.label: Visit Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the type of source data from which the visit record is derived.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the provider in the provider table who was associated with the visit.

fields.label: Care Site ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the care site in the care_site table that was visited.

fields.label: Visit Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the visit as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Visit Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Admitted From Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept in the Place of Service Vocabulary reflecting the admitting source for a visit.

fields.label: Admitted From Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the admitting source as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Discharged To Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined concept in the Place of Service Vocabulary reflecting the discharge disposition for a visit.

fields.label: Discharged To Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the discharge disposition as it appears in the source data.

fields.label: Preceding Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table of the visit immediately preceding this visit.
